# Guruvayur Live (https://guruvayurlive.in)

> Comprehensive Devotee Guide, Live Pooja Timings, Entry Regulations, and Visual Chronicle for the historic Guruvayur Sree Krishna Temple in Thrissur, Kerala, India.

## Core Temple Facts
- **Deity:** Lord Guruvayurappan (Four-armed Krishna carrying Conch, Discus, Mace, and Lotus).
- **Location:** Guruvayur, Thrissur District, Kerala, India (PIN: 680101). Geo: 10.5947° N, 76.0388° E.
- **Temple Timings (IST):**
  - Morning Session: 3:00 AM to 1:30 PM (Nada opens at 3:00 AM for Nirmalya Darshan).
  - Afternoon Interval: 1:30 PM to 4:30 PM (Sanctum closed).
  - Evening Session: 4:30 PM to 9:15 PM (Harivarasanam & Nada Adakkal at 9:15 PM).

## Daily Rituals & Pooja Timetable (IST)
- **03:00 AM:** Nirmalyam Darshan (Opening of sanctum sanctorum / Nada Thurakkal).
- **03:20 AM - 03:30 AM:** Thailabhishekam & Vakacharthu (Cleansing ritual).
- **03:30 AM - 04:15 AM:** Sankhabhishekam & Holy Milk/Water Abhishekams.
- **04:15 AM - 04:30 AM:** Malar Nivedyam & Alankaram.
- **04:30 AM - 06:15 AM:** Ethruthu Pooja & Morning Devotee Darshan.
- **06:15 AM - 07:00 AM:** Morning Seeveli (Caparisoned elephant circumambulation).
- **07:15 AM - 09:00 AM:** Pantheeradi Nivedyam & Continuous Darshan.
- **11:30 AM - 12:30 PM:** Navakabhishekam & Ucha Pooja (Midday feast and Paalpayasam).
- **01:30 PM:** Sanctum Closes for afternoon rest interval.
- **04:30 PM:** Evening Reopening (Nada Thurakkal).
- **04:30 PM - 05:00 PM:** Evening Seeveli procession with caparisoned elephants.
- **06:00 PM - 06:45 PM:** Deeparadhana (Grand illumination of thousands of brass oil lamps).
- **07:30 PM - 08:45 PM:** Athazha Pooja & Night Darshan.
- **08:45 PM - 09:15 PM:** Thrippuka (Herbal incense burning ceremony).
- **09:15 PM:** Harivarasanam lullaby and Nada Adakkal (Sanctum closes for the night).

## Strict Dress Code Guidelines
- **Men:** Traditional Dhoti (Mundu) worn around waist. Shirts, banyans, vests, pants, and jeans are strictly prohibited inside the inner temple complex. Angavastram (shoulder cloth) is permitted.
- **Women:** Saree, Set Mundu, Half-Saree (Pavada & Blouse), or Chudidhar/Salwar Kameez with Dupatta. Jeans, trousers, skirts, or western wear are strictly prohibited.
- **Prohibited Articles:** Mobile phones, cameras, smartwatches, leather belts, and footwear are strictly banned inside the inner courtyard. Free and paid cloakrooms are situated near East Nada.
